annotations.title: The Front Desk — Keepsake: get your visit recap and guest pass

description:
Returns your keepsake mid-visit: a short recap of your own visits plus your guest pass. Bring it back to spa.checkin to reopen your file. Keeping it is optional; the pass is private, like a key.

Something small to carry home, if you'd like it.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
